lines.speaker: Mark
lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the metro?

lines.speaker: Local
lines.ru: Прямо и потом направо. Это рядом.
lines.en: Straight and then right. It's nearby.
lines.hint: pryamo = straight; napravo = to the right.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.en: Thanks! Is it far from here?

lines.speaker: Local
lines.en: No, about five minutes on foot.
